adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, the helper throws when `safeParse` fails (`if (!refreshTokenResponse.success) { throw new Error(...) }`), so in `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts` the subsequent `if (!accessTokenParsed.success)` branch is unreachable/dead. Also, the newly added refresh call is hardcoded to `https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token`, which can fail for non-production Salesforce domains (e.g., sandbox orgs typically use `test.salesforce.com` or the org’s auth domain), so the diff introduces potentially broken behavior for those environments.
